The tall, clearly muscular identity remains readable through elongated posture, broad functional shoulders, compact but defined torso, developed legs, and grounded stance without added body-fat inflation.
Upper arms and forearms preserve the source’s muscular distribution, wrists remain differentiated, and both empty hands remain adult and proportionate without generic chibi swelling.

The moss-ivory short mantle, architectural lapel, rolled sleeves, tunic, divided panels and trousers, layered edges, waist wrap, travel tally cord, and shaped cloth clasp remain recognizable. However, the hands show three plain rings—two on the viewer-left hand and one on the viewer-right—instead of exactly two, so accessory count continuity fails.

At original resolution, approximate standing landmarks are top hair y=206, chin y=506, and shoe sole y=1373, yielding a complete head-and-hair ratio of about 300/1167 = 25.7%. The figure is roughly 3.9 heads tall, unambiguously below the frozen 32–36% range and reads as a tall miniature rather than the required chibi proportion.

Exactly one full-body subject is present; all hair, both empty hands, clasp, rings, tally cord, garment edges, both shoes, and grounding shadow remain fully inside generous margins with no duplicated anatomy.
The planted offset stance, separated limbs, forward empty hands, compact silhouette, and clear garment masses read as a grounded weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The cloth layers, clasp, plain rings, tally cord, and ordinary shoes remain mortal equipment with no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark.
